translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A1: Testbook Pass is a comprehensive, all-in-one membership that gives you unlimited access to all exam preparation resources on Testbook. It includes 1,50,000+ Mock Tests, 30,000+ Previous Year Papers, Unlimited Practice Questions, Unlimited Live Tests, unlimited reattempts, exclusive Study Notes for all covered exams, real-time 24×7 AI-doubt support, and Premium Test Series for 1000+ exams. It is available on the Testbook App & Website.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q2: What happened to Pass Pro, Pass Pro Max, and Pass Elite? And what about my earlier purchases of these subscriptions?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A2:
Testbook has merged all its previous Pass products — Pass, Pass Pro, Pass Pro Max, and Pass Elite — into a single unified Testbook Pass. The new Testbook Pass offers all the exams & features that were previously available separately in Pass, Pass Pro, Pass Pro Max, and Pass Elite making it easier for you to access the best resources without choosing between multiple plans.

Your existing subscription remains fully active and valid until its expiry date. You will continue to enjoy all the features available under your current plan without any disruption.

For Paid Users:
Students with an active subscription to Testbook Pass, Pass Pro, Pass Pro Max, or Pass Elite must update the app to access the All New Testbook Pass. Their remaining validity will be carried forward exactly as it is. If a student has multiple active subscriptions (e.g., Pass Pro and Pass Elite), the maximum validity among the subscriptions will be applied to the new Testbook Pass.

For Free Users:
Students who update the app will be able to enroll in the new Testbook Pass, which includes all the premium offerings previously available in Pass, Pass Pro, Pass Pro Max, and Pass Elite. They will also be able to purchase the new Testbook Pass without any platform fee.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q3: What are all the features included in Testbook Pass?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A3:
Testbook Pass includes:
• 1,50,000+ Mock Tests across 1000+ exams
• 30,000+ Previous Year Papers
• Unlimited Practice Questions
• Unlimited Live Tests
• Unlimited reattempts on all tests
• Special Tests, Previous Year Chapter Tests & Subject Tests
• Exclusive Study Notes for all covered exams
• Real-time 24×7 AI-doubt support

Testbook Pass is available on the Testbook App or website.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q4: Is Testbook Pass available on the website or only on the app?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A4: Testbook Pass is available on the Testbook App. While you can purchase and manage your Pass on both the website and app, certain features like Study Notes and 24×7 AI-doubt support are exclusively accessible through the official Testbook App.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q5: How many tests and exams do I get access to with Testbook Pass?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A5: With Testbook Pass, you get access to 1,50,000+ Mock Tests covering 1000+ exams. This includes SSC, Banking, Railways, Teaching, Defence, State Government exams, as well as premium exams like UPSC, IIT JEE, NEET, CAT, UGC NET, CSIR NET, IIT JAM, CUET UG, Judiciary, and Regulatory Bodies. New test series are continuously added as exam notifications are released.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q6: Can I attempt a test multiple times?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A6: Yes, Testbook Pass offers unlimited reattempts on all available tests. You can reattempt any test as many times as you want during your active subscription.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q7: What are Study Notes? Where can I access them?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A7: Study Notes are detailed, topic-oriented, and exam-focused notes curated specifically for competitive exams. They help students grasp key concepts quickly with a focus on the specific requirements of each exam. Study Notes are available for all exams covered under Testbook Pass. For security and content protection reasons, Study Notes are accessible only through the official Testbook App.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A8: The 24×7 AI-doubt support is a real-time doubt-solving feature powered by AI, available round the clock. It allows you to get instant answers to your exam-related doubts anytime, without waiting for a tutor. This feature is accessible only through the official Testbook App.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q9: Till when can I access the solutions and analysis of my attempted tests?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A9: You can access the solutions and detailed analysis of your attempted tests for as long as your Testbook Pass is valid, provided the individual test has not expired. Once a test expires, it can still be accessed for 15 more days after the test's individual expiry date.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q10: When will my Testbook Pass expire?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A10: The validity of your Testbook Pass depends on the plan you've purchased. You can check the expiration date on the Pass page or in your account settings within the app.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q11: What happens after my Testbook Pass expires?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A11: Once your Testbook Pass expires, you will no longer have access to Tests, Study Notes, Live Tests, Practice Questions, and other Pass features. To continue, you will need to renew your Pass. Attempted tests remain accessible for 15 days after their individual test expiry date.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q12: Will all my enrolled Test Series be available during my Pass validity?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A12: Yes, all enrolled Test Series will be available throughout your Testbook Pass validity period. You will have access to the latest test series for every exam you are enrolled in.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q13: Will my attempted tests be available for review during the validity period?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A13: Yes, all attempted tests are available for review during the active validity of your Testbook Pass, provided the individual test has not expired. Attempted tests remain accessible for 15 days after their individual test expiry date.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q14: How can I renew my Testbook Pass?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A14: You can renew your Testbook Pass anytime by visiting the Pass page in your account, where all available plans are listed. Once the renewal process is completed, your validity will be extended as per the plan selected.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q15: What happens if I renew before my Pass expires?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A15: If you renew before your Pass expires, the remaining days of your current subscription are added to the new plan. For example, if you renew a monthly Pass with 20 days remaining, your total new validity will be 50 days.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q16: If I renew, can I reattempt the tests I've already taken?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A16: Yes! With Testbook Pass, you can reattempt tests even after renewal. Your previously attempted tests remain accessible, and you can reattempt them as long as the tests are still within their active period.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q17: I do not have online payment activated. Can I use another payment method?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A17: Yes! You can use your Debit card, ATM card, Credit card, Net Banking, or payment wallets like Amazon Pay to purchase Testbook Pass. If none of these options work for you, please email us at support@testbook.com and we will suggest an alternative payment method.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q18: What is Autopay, and how does it work?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A18: Autopay is a recurring payment feature that automatically renews your Pass at regular intervals without manual intervention. You can identify Autopay-enabled products through the Autopay message shown in your UPI app during payment. You have full control and can cancel or pause the Autopay mandate at any time through your UPI app.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q19: My money got deducted twice during a transaction. What should I do?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A19: Generally, one of the duplicate transactions gets automatically refunded to your bank account. If the refund does not reflect within a few business days, please contact us at support@testbook.com with your order details, registered phone number, and identity proof, and we will resolve it promptly.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q20: My transaction failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A20: If your transaction failed but the amount was deducted, please email us at support@testbook.com with your order details, razorpay/payment gateway confirmation email screenshot, registered phone number, and identity proof. Our team will investigate and resolve the issue as quickly as possible.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q21: Can I get a refund after purchasing Testbook Pass?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A21: All Testbook Pass transactions are final. Refunds cannot be initiated once the payment is completed, as all transactions on the Testbook platform are non-refundable. We recommend reviewing all features, test coverage, and exam inclusions carefully before purchasing.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q22: Can I share my Testbook account with a friend or relative?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A22: No, sharing your Testbook account is strictly not allowed. Our systems actively detect account sharing, and accounts found to be shared may be blocked. Your Testbook Pass subscription is for individual use only. You can refer Testbook Pass to your friend at a discounted price and simultaneously earn cashback.
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_Q23: I need help or have a query about Testbook Pass. Who should I contact?
translate-global-english.PASS_FAQ_A23: For any support or queries related to Testbook Pass, please reach out to us at support@testbook.com. Our support team is available to help you with any issues or questions you may have.
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A1: Testbook Pass is a special membership that unlocks all Test Series e-book available on Testbook. Testbook Pass unlocks Test Series available on website/app.
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_Q2: How many tests and exam do I get when I buy the Testbook Pass?
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A2: With Testbook Pass, all the tests under all the exams on Testbook are unlocked. There is no limit on the tests that you can attempt after you buy the Pass. As long as your Pass is valid, you can take as many tests as you want. You can find all the available test series and test release plans on the Pass page. We cover over 50 exams as of now and will keep on adding new test series as and when new exam notifications are out. If you are not able to find your exam/test series, please write to support@testbook.com
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A3: It depends on which Pass you have purchased. Validity of the Pass is mentioned on the Pass and you can also check it in your account settings or on Pass
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_Q4: Will I be able to access Test Series e-book after my Pass expires?
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A4: No, You won't be able to access the Test Series e-book after your Pass expires. To access the same, you will have to renew the respective Pass.
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_Q5: Will all of my attempted tests be available during the Pass validity period?
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A5: Yes, till your Pass is valid you can review attempted tests provided Test hasn't expired. Test expiry date is independent of Testbook Pass expiry date. Attempted Tests are available for the next 15 days after the Test expiry date.
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_Q6: How can I renew my Testbook Pass?
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A6: You can renew the Testbook Pass anytime, just like you purchased it. Since the Pass has already been purchased, the renewal can be done by navigating to the page where plans are available. Once the renewal process has been completed, validity of your Pass will be extended accordingly.
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_Q7: If I renew the Pass, can I get to reattempt the tests that I have already taken?
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A7: No, attempted tests cannot be re-attempted. Although, you can reattempt all incorrect and skipped questions using the reattempt feature available for Tests. To access Attempted Tests, you must have a valid Pass.
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_Q8: What happens if I renew the Pass before the expiry date?
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A8: If you renew the Pass before the expiry date, the duration of Pass simply gets added to the remaining days in your currently active Pass. For example, if you renew your monthly Pass 20 days before the expiry date, your renewed Pass will now be valid for a total of 50 days.
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_Q9: Can I just purchase the Test Series e-book as I don't need evaluation of online Test Series?
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A9: Yes, you can purchase the same at a different price by going on to this link https://testbook.com/promos/mock-test-book.html
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_Q10: Can I take a print out of the Test Series e-book?
translate-global-english.PASS_LI_FAQ_A10: Testbook e-book can only be read on a computer or a hand-held device and is not available for downloading/ printing. However, printed version of the e-book can be separately made available if opted at a different price as mentioned on the website
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q1: Can I attempt a test multiple times?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A1: Free users can attempt a free test only once. However, paid users can attempt and reattempt any test unlimited times.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q2: Can I download the question paper with solutions after the test?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A2: No, you cannot download the paper; however, you can access the paper and its solutions by logging into your account on the website or on the App.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q3: Do you also provide solutions for the questions?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A3: Yes, detailed solutions will be available to you after you finish the test. You will be able to access these solutions anytime after you have taken the test.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q4: Will I get any report card after the test?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A4: Yes, you will get a detailed analysis of your performance after submitting the test.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q5: Till when can I access the solutions and analysis of my attempted tests?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A5: To access solutions and analysis, you should have a valid Pass and test should not have expired. Attempted Tests will be available for review till 15 days after Test Expiry date.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q6: Will all of my attempted tests be available during the Pass validity period?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A6: Yes, till your Pass is valid you can review attempted tests provided Test has not expired. Test expiry date is independent of Testbook Pass expiry date. Attempted Tests are available for the next 15 days after the Test expiry date.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q7: I am not able to access My Tests, what should I do?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A7: If you're unable to access My Tests, it is likely that your Testbook Pass has expired, and you may need to renew it to continue accessing the tests. If your Pass is still active and you're facing this issue, please reach out to our support team with registered details at support@testbook.com for assistance.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q8: I am not able to see Tests for my desired exam. What should I do?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A8: You can see all available test series for all exams in All Tests tab. Please ensure you are in the right exam (exam dropdown besides Testbook logo on top left corner). You will find your Tests in My Tests tab under respective Exam tabs. All your attempted tests should be available in Attempted Tests tab. If you are still not able to find your exam or tests, please write to support@testbook.com
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q9: I do not have a computer; can I attempt for the test through my phone?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A9: Yes, you may appear for the test through your phone. Simply download the Testbook App on your Android phone and take the tests there.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q10: What if my computer gets disconnected from internet during the test?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A10: No need to panic. We auto-pause your test and you can resume the test from where you left. You can also manually pause a test by clicking on the 'Pause' icon on the top left corner inside the timer circle. Please note that these functionalities are not available in a Live Test. Kindly ensure that you have an uninterrupted internet and power connection during the Live Tests.
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_Q11: If I am unavailable on the day of Live Test, can I attempt the test on any other day?
translate-global-english.TEST_FAQ_A11: No, you cannot attempt the test at any point other than the given time because appearing for the test at any other time will lose its value as a Live Test and it will be considered like any other practice test. Once the Live Test is over, you will be able to see the test along with its solutions.
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_Q1: I do not have online payment activated, can I use any other mode for payment?
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_A1: You can use your Debit card, ATM card, Credit card, Netbanking account or payment wallets like Amazon Pay to pay for the pass. If you do not have any of the above payment methods, send us an email at support@testbook.com and we will suggest an alternative method.
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_Q2: My money got deducted twice while making the transaction, what should I do?
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_A2: No need to worry! Generally, one of the transactions gets refunded back to your bank account automatically. In case this does not happen, you can reach out to us at support@testbook.com.
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_Q3: My transaction failed, but money got deducted from my account, what should I do?
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_A3: No need to worry! Generally, if failed, transactions gets refunded back to your bank account automatically. In case this does not happen, you can reach out to us at support@testbook.com.
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_Q4: I entered wrong email-id and/or phone number while making the transaction, what should I do?
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_A4: In case you have entered a wrong email-id or phone number, please send us an email at support@testbook.com with your payment receipt, Razorpay confirmation, correct phone number, correct email id and scanned copy of your identity proof (driving license/voter card/aadhar card).
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_Q5: How can I apply for the refund?
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_A5: Once purchased, there will be no refund for Testbook Pass. Hence, there is no process to apply for the same.
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_Q6: Will I get the refund if I want to stop using it before the Pass expiry?
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_A6: No, you will not get any refund if you want to stop using the Pass before expiry. Hence, please read the terms and conditions carefully before purchasing testbook pass , as once you have purchased you cannot change, cancel your purchased plan. Once you purchase and make the required payment, it shall be final and there cannot be any changes or modifications to the same.
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_Q7: Can I share my testbook account with my friend/relative?
translate-global-english.PAYMENT_FAQ_A7: No, You can not share your account with anyone. If you do so, Our systems will detect it and block your account immediately. You can refer Testbook Pass to your friend at a discounted price and simultaneously earn cashback.

translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_Q1: Why should one go for solving previous years' papers?
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_A1: Solving the previous years' papers is not only a good practice to check your preparedness for the exam, but will also make you experience the real-time examination.
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_Q2: Are the previous years' papers enough to prepare for the recruitment exams?
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_A2: No, candidates must start with preparing the topics from the syllabus first and then solve the previous years' papers in order to judge the speed, accuracy and hence prepare better.
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_Q3: Where will I get the previous years' papers?
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_A3: To get Previous Year Papers, open the Testbook app and navigate to the Test tab from the bottom menu. Once the page loads, scroll down until you find the Previous Papers section. From there, you can select the exam or paper you want and proceed to explore or attempt it.
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_Q4: How many previous years' papers are recommended for candidates to practice?
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_A4: There is no set limit of how many papers you can solve. Depending upon your preparation and time, you can go for solving as many papers as you can.
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_Q5: Will the previous years' papers be in accordance with the latest format?
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_A5: It is not necessary that the previous years' papers are of the latest format. For some exams, the current format may change while for others it might remain the same as in certain cases the exam pattern & syllabus have changed over the years.
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_Q6: Will the previous years' papers tell me the exact count of questions for different subjects?
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_A6: The previous years' papers cannot really let you know the exact count of the questions for different subjects. However, from previous years' papers, you can definitely make out the analysis so as to know which topic is asked the most.
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_Q7: Where I can download Previous Year Papers?
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_A7: To download Previous Year Papers, open the Testbook app and navigate to the Test tab from the bottom menu. Once the page loads, scroll down until you find the Previous Papers section. From there, you can select the exam or paper you want and proceed to download or attempt it.
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_Q8: Where I can attempt the previous year papers to know my rank?
translate-global-english.PYP_FAQ_A8: You can attempt the Previous Year Papers through the test series available on the platform. Simply go to the test series section, select the relevant previous year paper, and attempt the test. Once completed, your performance will be evaluated and you will be able to see your rank based on the test results.

faqs.answer: Usually, one transaction is refunded automatically. If not, contact support@testbook.com with your details.

faqs.question: 20. What if my transaction failed but money was deducted?
faqs.answer: Please email support@testbook.com with your order details, phone number, and ID proof. The team will resolve the issue.

faqs.question: 21. Can I get a refund after purchase?
faqs.answer: No, all Testbook Pass transactions are final and non-refundable.

faqs.question: 22. Can I share my Testbook account?
faqs.answer: No, account sharing is strictly prohibited. Violations may lead to account blocking. The subscription is for individual use only.

faqs.question: 23. Who should I contact for support?
faqs.answer: For any queries or support, contact support@testbook.com.
